purpose: Teach: ホセ/ブライアン/アダム/チャイルド/エリック/ビリー/アンナ/ソロモン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ホセ・カレーラスの歌覚えてたな
lines.en: Hey Riku — you were listening to José Carreras singing the other day, weren't you?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the opening. Casual, probing — she's caught him in something and wants to see if he'll admit it. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ブライアン・メイのギター練習してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were practicing Brian May guitar, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turning it back on her with a quick, quiet deflection. Slight edge — not defensive, just evening the score. Held eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でアダム・スミスの経済論調べてたな
lines.en: Riku — for social studies, you were researching Adam Smith's economics, right?
lines.style: Pressing in again. Knowing, deliberate. Naming something he probably thought was private. Soft challenge underneath the casual surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、チャイルドサポートのボランティア行ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were volunteering at the childcare support center last week, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet counterattack. He's done his homework on her too. Measured delivery — no heat, just facts. Settling something gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、エリック・クラプトンのギター聴いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were listening to Eric Clapton's guitar work, weren't you?
lines.style: Lighter now, almost conspiratorial. She's enjoying the back-and-forth. Quick attack on the name, softer on the observation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ビリー・アイリッシュの曲聴いてたろ、桜
lines.en: You were listening to Billie Eilish the other day, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, amused. He's caught onto the pattern and is playing along now. Slight warmth in the tone — the sparring is becoming its own kind of connection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アンナと文化祭で同じグループだったな
lines.en: Riku — you were in the same cultural festival group as Anna, right?
lines.style: Sharp pivot. The real thing she wanted to know all along, delivered faster than the others. Watching for his reaction. Trying to sound casual but not quite landing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でソロモン王の話聞いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were listening in social studies when they talked about King Solomon, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: A breath of relief in the delivery. Softer than before. He's deliberately choosing something ordinary to let her off the hook. Small kindness wrapped in casualness.
